{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Compute response rates by arm
response_by_arm = df_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
treatment_prop = response_by_arm['treatment']
control_prop = response_by_arm['control']
diff = treatment_prop - control_prop

# Compute response rates by severity
response_by_severity = df_dedup.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Deduplicated patient count: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Response rate in treatment arm: {treatment_prop}")
print(f"Response rate in control arm: {control_prop}")
print(f"Difference in proportions (treatment - control): {diff}")
print(f"Response rate by severity - mild: {response_by_severity['mild']}")
print(f"Response rate by severity - moderate: {response_by_severity['moderate']}")
print(f"Response rate by severity - severe: {response_by_severity['severe']}")

# Cross-tab for confirmation
print(f"Cross-tab: arm vs severity\n{pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'])}")"}
